description: Option quotes by strike or expiration. Retrieve option quote rows with bid/ask, Greeks, implied volatility, strike, expiration, and contract metadata. Provide strike, range, expiration, from, or to to narrow results. If no strike, range, expiration, from, or to selector is provided, range defaults to 1000. When strike and range are both provided, strike takes precedence and range is ignored. Use the /v3/symbols/quotes endpoint with returned option codes when you need last trade price and volume (up to 10 codes per request). → Returns {underlying_code: string, last_update: number, last_price?: number, data: [{code?: string, type: string, strike_price: number, expiration: number, ask_price: number, bid_price: number, delta: number, gamma: number, theta: number, vega: number, rho: number, implied_volatility: number, theoretical_price: number, bid_iv: number, ask_iv: number}]}. Use strike, range, expiration, from, or to to narrow results. If no strike, range, expiration, from, or to selector is provided, range defaults to 1000. Use type, sortBy, and sort to narrow results, then filter for Greek thresholds. To get last trade price and volume of returned contracts, call get_quotes with the option codes (up to 10). For historical option price data use get_symbol_series.

code.description: (Required) Symbol code in Exchange:Symbol format (e.g., NASDAQ:AAPL). Use search_symbols to find the correct code.

expiration.description: (Optional) Exact expiration date. Validated but not used when from or to is provided. (Format: YYYY-MM-DD; must be a valid calendar date)

filter.description: (Optional) JSONata expression to return only the fields or rows you need. See https://jsonata.org for syntax.

from.description: (Optional) Minimum expiration date. When provided, expiration parameter is ignored.  (Format: YYYY-MM-DD; must be a valid calendar date)

output_dir.description: Directory for stored response when output_file is not set.

range.description: (Optional) Strike price range as a percentage of the current underlying price. For example, range=10 returns only options with strikes within ±10% of the current price. Values above 1000 are capped at 1000. Ignored when strike is provided. If no strike, range, expiration, from, or to selector is provided, range defaults to 1000.

store.description: Store the response locally instead of returning it. Default is none. csv is only supported for get_symbol_series.

strike.description: (Optional) Strike price for exact match filtering.

to.description: (Optional) Maximum expiration date. When provided, expiration parameter is ignored. (Format: YYYY-MM-DD; must be a valid calendar date)

name: get_options_quotes
